skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Implement all steps and techniques of teaching vocabulary lessons.
Implement all steps and techniques of teaching grammar lessons.
Implement all steps and techniques of teaching listening skills lessons.
Implement all steps and techniques of teaching speaking skills lessons.
Implement all steps and techniques of teaching reading skills lessons.
Implement all steps and techniques of teaching writing skills lessons.
Create lesson plans that align with course objectives and student levels.
Choose appropriate materials from textbooks and supplementary sources.
Develop creative and effective activities for each type of lesson.
Identify suitable evaluation methods and tools for assessing students' English proficiency.
Understand and apply task-based language teaching methodologies.
Understand and apply communicative language teaching methodologies.
Demonstrate good classroom management practices including punctuality, clear communication, and engagement.
Work collaboratively with peers during discussions and group work.
Reflect on personal performance and provide constructive feedback to peers.
Apply critical thinking skills to evaluate teaching methods and materials.
Exhibit professional behavior and attitude in the classroom.
Design tasks and activities that effectively assess student understanding.
Design tests and evaluation methods that accurately measure student performance.
